  IslandDfs(matrix, visited, rows, cols, r - 1, c);

function MaxOperations(const nums: array of integer; k: integer): integer;
begin
  var freq := new Dictionary<integer, integer>;
  foreach var num in nums do
    if freq.ContainsKey(num) then
      freq[num] := freq[num] + 1
    else
      freq[num] := 1;
  var operations := 0;
  foreach var key in freq.Keys.ToArray do
  begin
    if not freq.ContainsKey(key) then
      continue;
    var countX := freq[key];
    if countX = 0 then
      continue;
    var y := k - key;
    if y = key then
    begin
      operations += freq[key] div 2;
      freq[key] := 0;
    end
    else if freq.ContainsKey(y) then
    begin
      var &match := Min(freq[key], freq[y]);
      operations += &match;
      freq[key] := 0;
      freq[y] := Max(0, freq[y] - &match);
    end
    else
      freq[key] := 0;
  end;
  Result := operations;
end;

function LargestRectangleArea(matrix: array of array of integer): integer;

  if matrix = nil then
  begin
    Result := 0;
    exit;
  end;
  var n := matrix[0].Length;
  var height := new integer[n + 1]; // sentinel at end
  var maxArea := 0;
  for var r := 0 to matrix.Length - 1 do
  begin
    for var i := 0 to n - 1 do
      if matrix[r][i] = 1 then
        height[i] := height[i] + 1
      else
        height[i] := 0;
    // stack using dynamic array of integers
    var st := new List<integer>;
    st.Add(-1);
    for var i := 0 to n do
    begin
      var curH := height[i];
      while (st.Count > 1) and (curH < height[st[st.Count - 1]]) do
      begin
        var h := height[st[st.Count - 1]];
        st.RemoveAt(st.Count - 1);
        var w := i - 1 - st[st.Count - 1];
        maxArea := Max(maxArea, h * w);
      end;
      st.Add(i);
    end;
  end;
  Result := maxArea;
end;

  // Implement simple QuickSelect using iterative partitioning
  var a := arr.Clone() as array of integer;
  var left := 0; var right := a.Length - 1;
  while True do
  begin
    var pivot := a[(left + right) div 2];
    var i := left; var j := right;
    while i <= j do

      while a[i] < pivot do i += 1;
      while a[j] > pivot do j -= 1;
      if i <= j then

        var tmp := a[i]; a[i] := a[j]; a[j] := tmp;
        i += 1; j -= 1;
      end;
    end;
    if k - 1 <= j then right := j
    else if k - 1 >= i then left := i
    else begin Result := a[k - 1]; exit; end;
  end;

  rec.Remove(node);

end;

      var z := n xor cand;

      graph[u] := new List<(integer, integer)>;
    if not graph.ContainsKey(v) then

        minHeap.Add((nextCost, nextIsland));

    else

  var maxHeap := new List<integer>;
  foreach var cnt in count.Values do
    maxHeap.Add(-cnt);

      maxHeap.RemoveAt(0);

    begin
      var el := q.Dequeue.Item1;
      maxHeap.Add(-el);
      maxHeap.Sort;
    end;
  end;
  
  Result := t;

function Merge(var arr, tempArr: array of integer; left, mid, right: integer): integer;
begin
  var i := left;
  var j := mid + 1;
  var k := left;
  var invCount := 0;

  while (i <= mid) and (j <= right) do
  begin
    if arr[i] <= arr[j] then
    begin
      tempArr[k] := arr[i];
      k += 1;
      i += 1;
    end
    else
    begin
      tempArr[k] := arr[j];
      invCount += (mid - i + 1);
      k += 1;
      j += 1;
    end;
  end;

  while i <= mid do
  begin
    tempArr[k] := arr[i];
    k += 1;
    i += 1;
  end;

  while j <= right do
  begin
    tempArr[k] := arr[j];
    k += 1;
    j += 1;
  end;

  for var idx := left to right do
    arr[idx] := tempArr[idx];

  Result := invCount;
end;

    invCount += MergeSort(arr, tempArr, mid + 1, right);
    invCount += Merge(arr, tempArr, left, mid, right);
  end;
  Result := invCount;
end;

instruction: Write a function to find the shortest path from the start point to the end point in a grid. The grid contains obstacles which cannot be passed and each move has a cost associated with it. The function should return the minimum cost to reach the end point. The grid is represented as a list of lists where 'S' is the start point, 'E' is the end point, 'X' is an obstacle, and '.' is a valid path. The cost of moving from one cell to an adjacent cell is 1.
output:
function FindShortestPathCost(grid: array of array of char): integer;
begin
  if (grid.Length = 0) or (grid[0].Length = 0) then
  begin
    Result := -1;
    exit;
  end;

  var rows := grid.Length;
  var cols := grid[0].Length;
  var directions := Arr((0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1), (-1, 0));
  var start: (integer, integer) := nil;
  var finish: (integer, integer) := nil;
  
  for var i := 0 to rows - 1 do
    for var j := 0 to cols - 1 do
    begin
      if grid[i][j] = 'S' then
        start := (i, j)
      else if grid[i][j] = 'E' then
        finish := (i, j);
    end;

  if (start = nil) or (finish = nil) then
  begin
    Result := -1;
    exit;
  end;

  var queue := new Queue<(integer, integer, integer)>;
  queue.Enqueue((start.Item1, start.Item2, 0));
  var visited := new HashSet<(integer, integer)>;
  visited.Add((start.Item1, start.Item2));

  while queue.Count > 0 do
  begin
    var (x, y, cost) := queue.Dequeue;
    if (x, y) = finish then
    begin
      Result := cost;
      exit;
    end;
    
    foreach var (dx, dy) in directions do
    begin
      var nx := x + dx;
      var ny := y + dy;
      if (nx >= 0) and (nx < rows) and (ny >= 0) and (ny < cols) and 
         (grid[nx][ny] <> 'X') and not visited.Contains((nx, ny)) then
      begin
        visited.Add((nx, ny));
        queue.Enqueue((nx, ny, cost + 1));
      end;
    end;
  end;

  Result := -1;
end;

end.

  end;

  var right := nums.Length - 1;

  begin
    var mid := (left + right) div 2;
    if nums[mid] > nums[right] then
      left := mid + 1
    else
      right := mid;
  end;

    var mid := (left + right) div 2;
    if nums[mid] = target then
    begin
      Result := mid;
      exit;
    end
    else if nums[mid] < target then
      left := mid + 1
    else
      right := mid - 1;
  end;
  Result := -1;
end;

  if (nums.Length = 0) then
  begin
    Result := -1;
    exit;
  end;
  
  var start := 0;
  var finish := nums.Length - 1;
  
  while start + 1 < finish do

    var mid := (start + finish) div 2;
    
    if nums[mid] = target then

      Result := mid;

    else if (nums[mid] >= nums[start]) and (target < nums[mid]) and (target >= nums[start]) then

      start := mid
    else if (nums[mid] <= nums[finish]) and (target > nums[mid]) and (target <= nums[finish]) then
      start := mid
    else
      finish := mid;
  end;
  
  if nums[start] = target then
    Result := start
  else if nums[finish] = target then

Write a function that checks if a given grid has a valid path from the top-left corner to the bottom-right corner. A valid path can only be made through connected streets, and you cannot change any street. Grid cells represent streets as follows:
1: a street connecting the left cell and the right cell.
2: a street connecting the upper cell and the lower cell.
3: a street connecting the left cell and the lower cell.
4: a street connecting the right cell and the lower cell.
5: a street connecting the left cell and the upper cell.
6: a street connecting the right cell and the upper cell.
output:
function Dfs(r, c: integer; const grid: array of array of integer; var seen: HashSet<integer>): boolean;
begin
  var height := grid.Length;
  var width := grid[0].Length;
  var key := r * width + c;
  
  if seen.Contains(key) then
  begin
    Result := false;
    exit;
  end;
  
  seen.Add(key);
  
  if (r = height - 1) and (c = width - 1) then
  begin
    Result := true;
    exit;
  end;
  
  var diffs := |(1,0), (-1,0), (0,1), (0,-1)|;
  var streets := new Dictionary<integer, HashSet<string>>;
  
  streets[1] := new HashSet<string>(|'l', 'r'.ToString()|);
  streets[2] := new HashSet<string>(|'u', 'd'.ToString()|);
  streets[3] := new HashSet<string>(|'l', 'd'.ToString()|);
  streets[4] := new HashSet<string>(|'r', 'd'.ToString()|);
  streets[5] := new HashSet<string>(|'l', 'u'.ToString()|);
  streets[6] := new HashSet<string>(|'u', 'r'.ToString()|);
  
  var depToArr := new Dictionary<string, string>;
  depToArr['d'] := 'u';
  depToArr['u'] := 'd';
  depToArr['r'] := 'l';
  depToArr['l'] := 'r';
  
  foreach var (rowDiff, colDiff) in diffs do
  begin
    var newRow := r + rowDiff;
    var newCol := c + colDiff;
    
    if (newRow < 0) or (newRow >= height) or (newCol < 0) or (newCol >= width) then
      continue;
    
    var newKey := newRow * width + newCol;
    if seen.Contains(newKey) then
      continue;
    
    var departureDirection: string;
    if rowDiff = 1 then
      departureDirection := 'd'
    else if rowDiff = -1 then
      departureDirection := 'u'
    else if colDiff = 1 then
      departureDirection := 'r'
    else
      departureDirection := 'l';
    
    var arrivalDirection := depToArr[departureDirection];
    
    if not streets[grid[r][c]].Contains(departureDirection) or not streets[grid[newRow][newCol]].Contains(arrivalDirection) then
      continue;
    
    if Dfs(newRow, newCol, grid, seen) then
    begin
      Result := true;
      exit;
    end;
  end;
  
  Result := false;
end;

function HasValidPath(grid: array of array of integer): boolean;
begin
  var seen := new HashSet<integer>;
  Result := Dfs(0, 0, grid, seen);
end;

function PrimMST(edges: array of (integer, integer, integer)): real;
begin
  var vertices := edges.SelectMany(e -> [e[0], e[1]]).ToHashSet;
  var startVertex := vertices.First;
  var adjacentEdges := Dict(vertices.Select(v -> (v, new List<(real, integer)>)));
  
  foreach var edge in edges do
  begin
    adjacentEdges[edge[0]].Add((edge[2], edge[1]));
    adjacentEdges[edge[1]].Add((edge[2], edge[0]));
  end;
  
  var visited := new HashSet<integer>([startVertex]);
  var edgeHeap := new List<(real, integer)>(adjacentEdges[startVertex]);
  var totalWeight := 0.0;
  
  while visited.Count < vertices.Count do
  begin
    edgeHeap.Add((real.PositiveInfinity, 0));
    edgeHeap.Sort((x, y) -> x[0].CompareTo(y[0]));
    var (weight, vertex) := edgeHeap.First;
    edgeHeap.RemoveAt(0);
    
    while vertex in visited do
    begin
      (weight, vertex) := edgeHeap.First;
      edgeHeap.RemoveAt(0);
    end;
    
    visited.Add(vertex);
    totalWeight += weight;
    
    foreach var edge in adjacentEdges[vertex] do
      edgeHeap.Add(edge);
  end;
  
  Result := totalWeight;
end;

end.

  rest.Sort;
  numList.RemoveRange(i + 1, length - i - 1);

function CheckBinaryTree(preorder: string): boolean;

  var nodes := preorder.Split(',').ToList;
  if nodes[0] = '#' then
  begin
    if nodes.Count = 1 then
      Result := True
    else
      Result := False;
    exit;
  end;
  
  var stack := new Stack<integer>;
  for var i := 0 to nodes.Count - 1 do
  begin
    var ch := nodes[i];
    if ch = '#' then
    begin
      if stack.Count = 0 then
      begin
        Result := False;
        exit;
      end;
      stack.Push(stack.Pop - 1);
      while (stack.Count > 0) and (stack.Peek <= 0) do
      begin
        stack.Pop;
        if stack.Count > 0 then
          stack.Push(stack.Pop - 1);
      end;
    end
    else
    begin
      if (i <> 0) and (stack.Count = 0) then
      begin
        Result := False;
        exit;
      end;
      stack.Push(2);
    end;
  end;
  
  Result := stack.Count = 0;
end;

end.

type
  TreeNode = class
    val: integer;
    left, right: TreeNode;
    
    constructor Create(v: integer; l: TreeNode := nil; r: TreeNode := nil);
    begin
      val := v;
      left := l;
      right := r;
    end;
  end;

procedure InorderTraversal(root: TreeNode; var arr: List<integer>);
begin
  if root <> nil then
  begin
    InorderTraversal(root.left, arr);
    arr.Add(root.val);
    InorderTraversal(root.right, arr);
  end;
end;

function BuildBST(sortedArr: List<integer>; startIndex, endIndex: integer): TreeNode;
begin
  if startIndex > endIndex then
  begin
    Result := nil;
    exit;
  end;
  
  var mid := (startIndex + endIndex) div 2;
  Result := new TreeNode(sortedArr[mid]);
  Result.left := BuildBST(sortedArr, startIndex, mid - 1);
  Result.right := BuildBST(sortedArr, mid + 1, endIndex);
end;

function CreateBST(arr: array of integer): TreeNode;
begin
  if arr.Length = 0 then
  begin
    Result := nil;
    exit;
  end;
  
  var sortedArr := arr.ToList;
  sortedArr.Sort;
  Result := BuildBST(sortedArr, 0, sortedArr.Count - 1);
end;

function IntersectionOfTwoBST(tree1, tree2: array of integer): array of integer;
begin
  var bst1 := CreateBST(tree1);
  var bst2 := CreateBST(tree2);
  
  var arr1 := new List<integer>;
  var arr2 := new List<integer>;
  
  InorderTraversal(bst1, arr1);
  InorderTraversal(bst2, arr2);
  
  var i := 0;
  var j := 0;
  var res := new List<integer>;
  
  while (i < arr1.Count) and (j < arr2.Count) do
  begin
    if arr1[i] < arr2[j] then
      i += 1
    else if arr1[i] > arr2[j] then
      j += 1
    else
    begin
      res.Add(arr1[i]);
      i += 1;
      j += 1;
    end;
  end;
  
  Result := res.ToArray;
end;

end.

    else

      if sortedNums[i] = sortedNums[i + 1] then
      begin
        Result := False;
        exit;
      end;
    end;

  Result := sortedNums[4] - sortedNums[joker] < 5;

function CanFormSquareComb(a, b, c, d, i: integer; nums: array of integer; q: integer): boolean;
begin
    if i = nums.Length then
    begin
      Result := (a = q) and (b = q) and (c = q) and (d = q);
      exit;
    end;
    
    var sides := new integer[4];
    sides[0] := a;
    sides[1] := b;
    sides[2] := c;
    sides[3] := d;
    
    for var j := 0 to 3 do
    begin
      if sides[j] + nums[i] <= q then
      begin
        sides[j] += nums[i];
        if CanFormSquareComb(sides[0], sides[1], sides[2], sides[3], i + 1, nums, q) then
        begin
          Result := True;
          exit;
        end;
        sides[j] -= nums[i];
      end;
    end;
    Result := False;
end;

function CanFormSquare(nums: array of integer): boolean;

  var S := nums.Sum;
  if S mod 4 <> 0 then
  begin
    Result := False;
    exit;
  end;
  
  var q := S div 4;
  var N := nums.Length;
  if N <= 3 then
  begin
    Result := False;
    exit;
  end;
  
  var sortedNums := nums.ToList;
  sortedNums.Sort;
  sortedNums.Reverse;
  
  Result := CanFormSquareComb(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, sortedNums.ToArray, q);
end;

begin

function BinaryXor(binary1, binary2: string): string;
begin
  var maxLength := Max(binary1.Length, binary2.Length);
  var res := '';
  
  for var i := 1 to maxLength do
  begin
    var bit1 := if i <= binary1.Length then StrToInt(binary1[binary1.Length - i + 1]) else 0;
    var bit2 := if i <= binary2.Length then StrToInt(binary2[binary2.Length - i + 1]) else 0;
    var xorBit := bit1 xor bit2;
    res := xorBit.ToString + res;
  end;
  
  Result := res;
end;

function IsValidInterleaving(s, t, resultStr: string): boolean;
begin
  if resultStr.Length <> s.Length + t.Length then
  begin
    Result := False;
    exit;
  end;
  
  var dp := new boolean[s.Length + 1, t.Length + 1];
  dp[0, 0] := True;
  
  for var i := 1 to s.Length do
    dp[i, 0] := dp[i - 1, 0] and (s[i] = resultStr[i]);
  
  for var j := 1 to t.Length do
    dp[0, j] := dp[0, j - 1] and (t[j] = resultStr[j]);
  
  for var i := 1 to s.Length do
    for var j := 1 to t.Length do
    begin
      dp[i, j] := (dp[i - 1, j] and (s[i] = resultStr[i + j])) or
                  (dp[i, j - 1] and (t[j] = resultStr[i + j]));
    end;
  
  Result := dp[s.Length, t.Length];
end;

begin
end.

function MinDelPalindrome(s: string): integer;
begin
  var n := s.Length;
  var dp := new integer[n, n];
  
  for var length := 2 to n do
  begin
    for var start := 0 to n - length do
    begin
      var endIndex := start + length - 1;
      if s[start + 1] = s[endIndex + 1] then
        dp[start, endIndex] := dp[start + 1, endIndex - 1]
      else
        dp[start, endIndex] := Min(dp[start + 1, endIndex], dp[start, endIndex - 1]) + 1;
    end;
  end;
  
  Result := dp[0, n - 1];
end;

begin
end.

function Encode(strs: array of string): string;

function Decode(encodedStr: string): array of string;

    while (j < encodedStr.Length) and (encodedStr[j + 1] <> '#') do

    var length := StrToInt(encodedStr.Substring(i, j - i + 1));
    req.Add(encodedStr.Substring(j + 2, length));
    i := j + 2 + length;
  end;
  
  Result := req.ToArray;
end;

function EncodeDecode(strs: array of string): array of string;
begin

      cnt += 1;
      idx += 2;
    end;

instruction: Write a function to find the minimum steps required to reach the end of a matrix with given start and end cells. You can move to any of its four adjacent cells in one step.

function MinPathSteps(matrix: array [,] of integer; start, endPos: (integer, integer)): integer;
begin
  var queue := new Queue<(integer, integer, integer)>;
  queue.Enqueue((start[0], start[1], 0));
  var directions := |(0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1), (-1, 0)|;
  
  var rows := matrix.GetLength(0);
  var cols := matrix.GetLength(1);
  var visited := new HashSet<(integer, integer)>;
  
  while queue.Count > 0 do
  begin
    var (x, y, steps) := queue.Dequeue;
    if (x = endPos[0]) and (y = endPos[1]) then
    begin
      Result := steps;
      exit;
    end;
    
    foreach var (dx, dy) in directions do
    begin
      var newX := x + dx;
      var newY := y + dy;
      if (newX >= 0) and (newX < rows) and (newY >= 0) and (newY < cols) and 
         (not visited.Contains((newX, newY))) and (matrix[newX, newY] = 0) then
      begin
        queue.Enqueue((newX, newY, steps + 1));
        visited.Add((newX, newY));
      end;
    end;
  end;
  
  Result := -1;
end;

begin
end.

      Result := letters[mid];

    else if letters[mid] <= target then

        while (left < right) and (sortedNums[right] = sortedNums[right - 1]) do

  while True do
  begin
    var code := '';
    for var i := 1 to 6 do
      code += Letters[Random(Letters.Length) + 1];
    
    if not FullTiny.Values.Contains(code) then

    Result := PrefixStr + FullTiny[longUrl]
  else
  begin
    var code := GenerateUniqueCode(FullTiny);
    FullTiny.Add(longUrl, code);
    Result := PrefixStr + code;
  end;
end;

  foreach var pair in FullTiny do

  var counts := new Dictionary<integer, integer>;
  foreach var num in nums do
    if counts.ContainsKey(num) then

    else
      counts.Add(num, 1);
  
  var sortedKeys := counts.Keys.ToList;

    var occ := counts[key];

        if (not counts.ContainsKey(i)) or (counts[i] < occ) then
        begin
          Result := False;

  var rest := digits.GetRange(i + 1, digits.Count - i - 1);

function Change(amount: integer; coins: array of integer): integer;

  var rows := coins.Length + 1;
  var cols := amount + 1;
  var cache := new integer[rows, cols];
  
  for var i := 0 to cols - 1 do
    cache[0, i] := 0;
  
  for var i := 0 to rows - 1 do
    cache[i, 0] := 1;
  
  for var i := 1 to rows - 1 do
  begin
    var coin := coins[i - 1];
    for var target := 1 to amount do
    begin
      cache[i, target] := cache[i - 1, target];
      var residual := target - coin;
      if residual >= 0 then
        cache[i, target] += cache[i, residual];
    end;
  end;
  
  Result := cache[rows - 1, cols - 1];
end;

    var tempIndex := index[i];
    index[i] := index[least];
    index[least] := tempIndex;

  var height := new integer[n + 1];

    var stack := new Stack<integer>;

        var w := j - 1 - stack.Peek;
        maxArea := Max(maxArea, h * w);

  lasts[0] := 0;
  
  for var i := 1 to status - 1 do
  begin
    for var j := 0 to n - 1 do
    begin
      var todo := i and (1 shl (n - 1 - j));
      if todo <> 0 then
      begin
        var pre := i - (1 shl (n - 1 - j));
        var lastVal := lasts[pre] + tasks[j];

          lastVal := tasks[j];

        begin
          nums[i] := numVal;

function FindFirstOccurrence(nums: array of integer; target: integer; startIdx, endIdx: integer): integer;

  var left := startIdx;
  var right := endIdx;
  while left < right do
  begin
    var mid := left + (right - left) div 2;
    if nums[mid] < target then
      left := mid + 1
    else
      right := mid;
  end;
  if nums[left] = target then
    Result := left
  else
    Result := -1;
end;

function FindLastOccurrence(nums: array of integer; target: integer; startIdx, endIdx: integer): integer;

  var right := endIdx;
  while left < right do
  begin
    var mid := left + (right - left + 1) div 2;
    if nums[mid] > target then
      right := mid - 1
    else
      left := mid;
  end;
  if nums[right] = target then
    Result := right
  else
    Result := -1;
end;

instruction: Write a function to find the number of closed islands in a given grid. A closed island is an area of 0s that is completely surrounded by 1s and is not connected to the borders of the grid. Grids are represented as a list of lists, where each sub-list represents a row of the grid and each element in the sub-list represents the value of the grid at that position (0 or 1).

function IsValid(row, col, R, C: integer): boolean;
begin
  Result := (row >= 0) and (row < R) and (col >= 0) and (col < C);
end;

function IsBorder(row, col, R, C: integer): boolean;
begin
  Result := (row = 0) or (row = R - 1) or (col = 0) or (col = C - 1);
end;

procedure BFS(grid: array of array of integer; row, col, R, C: integer; directions: array of (integer, integer));
begin
  grid[row, col] := 1;
  var queue := new Queue<(integer, integer)>;
  queue.Enqueue((row, col));
  
  while queue.Count > 0 do
  begin
    var (currR, currC) := queue.Dequeue;
    
    for var i := 0 to directions.Length - 1 do
    begin
      var (dr, dc) := directions[i];
      var nr := currR + dr;
      var nc := currC + dc;
      
      if IsValid(nr, nc, R, C) and (grid[nr, nc] = 0) then
      begin
        grid[nr, nc] := 1;
        queue.Enqueue((nr, nc));
      end;
    end;
  end;
end;

function ClosedIsland(grid: array of array of integer): integer;
begin
  var R := grid.Length;
  var C := grid[0].Length;
  var directions := Arr((1, 0), (0, 1), (-1, 0), (0, -1));
  
  for var row := 0 to R - 1 do
    for var col := 0 to C - 1 do
      if IsBorder(row, col, R, C) and (grid[row, col] = 0) then
        BFS(grid, row, col, R, C, directions);
  
  var res := 0;
  for var row := 0 to R - 1 do
    for var col := 0 to C - 1 do
      if grid[row, col] = 0 then
      begin
        BFS(grid, row, col, R, C, directions);
        res += 1;
      end;
  
  Result := res;
end;

begin
end.

instruction: Write a function that determines if a given list of words is a valid word square. A word square is a set of words that can be arranged in a grid where the n-th row and column are the same for all n. Additionally, the function should check if the word square is a magic square, meaning the sum of the values of the letters in each row and column are equal (a=1, b=2, ..., z=26).

function IsValidWordSquare(words: array of string): boolean;
begin
  if words.Length = 0 then
  begin
    Result := true;
    exit;
  end;
  
  var n := words.Length;
  for var i := 0 to n - 1 do
    for var j := 0 to words[i].Length - 1 do
      if (j >= n) or (i >= words[j].Length) or (words[i][j] <> words[j][i]) then
      begin
        Result := false;
        exit;
      end;
  
  Result := true;
end;

function IsMagicWordSquare(words: array of string): boolean;
begin
  if not IsValidWordSquare(words) then
  begin
    Result := false;
    exit;
  end;
  
  var n := words.Length;
  var rowSum := 0;
  for var i := 0 to words[0].Length - 1 do
    rowSum += Ord(words[0][i]) - Ord('a') + 1;
  
  for var i := 1 to n - 1 do
  begin
    var currentRowSum := 0;
    for var j := 0 to words[i].Length - 1 do
      currentRowSum += Ord(words[i][j]) - Ord('a') + 1;
    if currentRowSum <> rowSum then
    begin
      Result := false;
      exit;
    end;
  end;
  
  for var j := 0 to n - 1 do
  begin
    var colSum := 0;
    for var i := 0 to n - 1 do
      colSum += Ord(words[i][j]) - Ord('a') + 1;
    if colSum <> rowSum then
    begin
      Result := false;
      exit;
    end;
  end;
  
  Result := true;
end;

function BoyerMooreSearch(text, pattern: string): integer;

The function should take four parameters:
- `s1`: The first string.
- `n1`: The number of times the first string is repeated.
- `s2`: The second string.
- `n2`: The number of times to count the repetitions of the second string within the first.

The function should return the maximum number of repetitions of `s2` within `s1` repeated `n1` times, divided by `n2`.
output:
function GetMaxRepetitions(s1: string; n1: integer; s2: string; n2: integer): integer;
begin
  var countS1 := new Dictionary<char, integer>;
  var countS2 := new Dictionary<char, integer>;
  
  for var i := 0 to s1.Length - 1 do
  begin
    if not countS1.ContainsKey(s1[i]) then
      countS1[s1[i]] := 0;
    countS1[s1[i]] += 1;
  end;
  
  for var i := 0 to s2.Length - 1 do
  begin
    if not countS2.ContainsKey(s2[i]) then
      countS2[s2[i]] := 0;
    countS2[s2[i]] += 1;
  end;
  
  foreach var ch in countS2.Keys do
    if not countS1.ContainsKey(ch) then
    begin
      Result := 0;
      exit;
    end;
  
  var l1 := s1.Length;
  var l2 := s2.Length;
  var i1 := 0;
  var i2 := 0;
  var total := l1 * n1;
  var dic := new Dictionary<(integer, integer), (integer, integer)>;
  
  while i1 < total do
  begin
    if s1[i1 mod l1] = s2[i2 mod l2] then
    begin
      var key := (i1 mod l1, i2 mod l2);
      if dic.ContainsKey(key) then
      begin
        var (prev1, prev2) := dic[key];
        var cir1 := i1 - prev1;
        var cir2 := i2 - prev2;
        var countCir1 := (total - i1) div cir1;
        i1 += countCir1 * cir1;
        i2 += countCir1 * cir2;
        if i1 >= total then break;
      end
      else
        dic[key] := (i1, i2);
      i2 += 1;
    end;
    i1 += 1;
  end;
  
  Result := i2 div (l2 * n2);
end;

      if not visited.Contains(neiCity) then

        visited.Add(neiCity);
        changes += cost;

  end;

end;

    if (i <= candidates - 1) or (i >= costs.Length - candidates) then

      minHeap.Add((costs[i], i));
      seenIndex.Add(i);

      seenIndex.Add(left);

    else if (index >= right) and (left < right) and (not seenIndex.Contains(right - 1)) then
    begin
      right -= 1;
      minHeap.Add((costs[right], right));

  var counter1 := new Dictionary<char, integer>;
  var counter2 := new Dictionary<char, integer>;
  
  for var i := 0 to str1.Length - 1 do

    if not counter1.ContainsKey(str1[i]) then
      counter1[str1[i]] := 0;
    counter1[str1[i]] += 1;

  for var i := 0 to str2.Length - 1 do

      counter2[str2[i]] := 0;
    counter2[str2[i]] += 1;

      totalDeletions += pair.Value;
  end;
  
  foreach var pair in counter2 do
  begin
    var char := pair.Key;
    if not counter1.ContainsKey(char) then

  var low := 0;
  var high := arr.Length - 1;
  
  while low <= high do
  begin
    if arr[low] <= arr[high] then
    begin
      Result := low;
      exit;
    end;
    
    var mid := (low + high) div 2;
    var next := (mid + 1) mod arr.Length;
    var prev := (mid - 1 + arr.Length) mod arr.Length;
    
    if (arr[mid] <= arr[next]) and (arr[mid] <= arr[prev]) then
    begin
      Result := mid;
      exit;
    end
    else if arr[mid] <= arr[high] then
      high := mid - 1
    else
      low := mid + 1;
  end;

end;

instruction: Write a function to find the longest duplicated substring in a given string. The function should return the longest duplicated substring found in the string.

function LongestDupSubstring(S: string): string;
begin
  var res := '';
  var l := 0;
  var r := S.Length - 1;
  var aNum := Ord('a');

  while l <= r do
  begin
    var tmp: string := nil;
    var id := 0;
    var existence := new HashSet<integer>;
    var size := l + (r - l) div 2;
    var tem := Round(Power(26, size - 1));

    for var i := 0 to size - 1 do
      id := id * 26 + (Ord(S[i]) - aNum);

    existence.Add(id);

    for var i := size to S.Length - 1 do
    begin
      var tail := S[i];
      var prevHead := S[i - size];
      id := (id - (Ord(prevHead) - aNum) * tem) * 26 + (Ord(tail) - aNum);

      if existence.Contains(id) then
      begin
        tmp := S.Substring(i - size + 1, size);
        break;
      end;
      existence.Add(id);
    end;

    if tmp <> nil then
    begin
      l := size + 1;
      res := tmp;
    end
    else
      r := size - 1;
  end;

  Result := res;
end;

begin

function GetBadCharacterShift(pattern: string): Dictionary<char, integer>;
begin
  var badCharShift := new Dictionary<char, integer>;
  for var i := 0 to pattern.Length - 2 do
    badCharShift[pattern[i]] := pattern.Length - i - 1;
  Result := badCharShift;
end;

function BoyerMooreSearch(text, pattern: string): integer;
begin
  var textLength := text.Length;
  var patternLength := pattern.Length;

  if patternLength > textLength then
  begin
    Result := -1;
    exit;
  end;

  var badCharShift := GetBadCharacterShift(pattern);
  var i := patternLength - 1;

  while i < textLength do
  begin
    var j := patternLength - 1;
    while (j >= 0) and (text[i] = pattern[j]) do
    begin
      i -= 1;
      j -= 1;
    end;

    if j < 0 then
    begin
      Result := i + 1;
      exit;
    end;

    var shift := patternLength;
    if badCharShift.ContainsKey(text[i]) then
      shift := badCharShift[text[i]];
    i += shift;
  end;

  Result := -1;
end;

begin
end.

  end;

procedure BFS(isConnected: List<List<integer>>; node: integer; var visited: array of boolean);
begin
  var q := new Queue<integer>;
  q.Enqueue(node);
  
  while q.Count > 0 do
  begin
    var cur := q.Dequeue;
    if not visited[cur] then
    begin
      visited[cur] := True;
      for var neighbor := 0 to isConnected.Count - 1 do
        if isConnected[cur][neighbor] = 1 then
          if not visited[neighbor] then
            q.Enqueue(neighbor);
    end;
  end;
end;

  var n := isConnected.Count;
  var visited := ArrFill(n, False);
  var circles := 0;
  
  for var i := 0 to n - 1 do
    if not visited[i] then
    begin
      BFS(isConnected, i, visited);
      circles += 1;
    end;
  
  Result := circles;
end;

      k += 1;
      i += 1;

    k += 1;
    i += 1;
  end;

    tempArr[k] := arr[j];
    k += 1;
    j += 1;
  end;
  
  for var loopVar := left to right do
    arr[loopVar] := tempArr[loopVar];
  
  Result := invCount;
end;

function FindQuadruplets(nums: List<integer>; target: integer): List<List<integer>>;
begin
  nums.Sort;
  var results := new List<List<integer>>;
  var n := nums.Count;
  
  for var i := 0 to n - 3 do
  begin
    if (i > 0) and (nums[i] = nums[i - 1]) then continue;
    
    for var j := i + 1 to n - 2 do
    begin
      if (j > i + 1) and (nums[j] = nums[j - 1]) then continue;
      
      var left := j + 1;
      var right := n - 1;
      
      while left < right do
      begin
        var total := nums[i] + nums[j] + nums[left] + nums[right];
        if total = target then
        begin
          results.Add(new List<integer>(|nums[i], nums[j], nums[left], nums[right]|));
          while (left < right) and (nums[left] = nums[left + 1]) do
            left := left + 1;
          while (left < right) and (nums[right] = nums[right - 1]) do
            right := right - 1;
          left := left + 1;
          right := right - 1;
        end
        else if total < target then
          left := left + 1
        else
          right := right - 1;
      end;
    end;
  end;
  
  Result := results;
end;

begin

  foreach var edge in edges do
  begin
    var start := edge[0];
    var endVal := edge[1];
    
    if not d.ContainsKey(start) then
      d.Add(start, new HashSet<integer>);
    if not d.ContainsKey(endVal) then
      d.Add(endVal, new HashSet<integer>);
      
    d[start].Add(endVal);
    d[endVal].Add(start);
  end;
  
  var q := new List<integer>;
  foreach var kv in d do

      q.Add(kv.Key);
  
  while n > 2 do

    foreach var i in q do
    begin
      var j := d[i].First;
      d[j].Remove(i);
      if d[j].Count = 1 then

      n := n - 1;
    end;
    q := t;
  end;
  
  Result := q;
end;

type
  PriorityQueue<T> = class
  private
    data: List<(T, integer)>;
    
    procedure Swap(i, j: integer);
    begin
      var temp := data[i];
      data[i] := data[j];
      data[j] := temp;
    end;
    
    procedure HeapifyUp(index: integer);
    begin
      if index = 0 then exit;
      var parent := (index - 1) div 2;
      if data[index].Item2 < data[parent].Item2 then
      begin
        Swap(index, parent);
        HeapifyUp(parent);
      end;
    end;
    
    procedure HeapifyDown(index: integer);
    begin
      var left := 2 * index + 1;
      var right := 2 * index + 2;
      var smallest := index;
      
      if (left < data.Count) and (data[left].Item2 < data[smallest].Item2) then
        smallest := left;
      if (right < data.Count) and (data[right].Item2 < data[smallest].Item2) then
        smallest := right;
      
      if smallest <> index then
      begin
        Swap(index, smallest);
        HeapifyDown(smallest);
      end;
    end;
    
  public
    constructor;
    begin
      data := new List<(T, integer)>;
    end;
    
    procedure Enqueue(item: T; priority: integer);
    begin
      data.Add((item, priority));
      HeapifyUp(data.Count - 1);
    end;
    
    function Dequeue: T;
    begin
      if data.Count = 0 then
        raise new System.InvalidOperationException('Queue is empty');
      
      Result := data[0].Item1;
      data[0] := data[data.Count - 1];
      data.RemoveAt(data.Count - 1);
      
      if data.Count > 0 then
        HeapifyDown(0);
    end;
    
    function Count: integer;
    begin
      Result := data.Count;
    end;
  end;

function KthSmallestNum(arr: List<integer>; k: integer): integer;
begin
  var heap := new PriorityQueue<integer>;
  
  foreach var num in arr do
    heap.Enqueue(num, num);
  
  for var i := 1 to k - 1 do
    heap.Dequeue;
  
  Result := heap.Dequeue;
end;

begin
end.

  var maxLength := 0;

      if (stack.Count = 0) or (stack.Peek() <> mapping[char]) then

  DFS(matrix, i, j + 1, path, 'R');

  path.Append('B');

procedure CountWays(numbers: List<integer>; i: integer; var counts: List<List<integer>>);

  var n := numbers.Count;
  var plus := numbers.GetRange(0, n - i);
  if i = 1 then
  begin
    foreach var count in counts.ToList do
    begin
      var newCount := new List<integer>(plus);
      newCount.Add(-1 * numbers[n - i]);
      counts.Add(newCount);
    end;
  end
  else
  begin
    foreach var count in counts.ToList do
    begin
      var newCount := new List<integer>(plus);
      newCount.Add(-1 * numbers[n - i]);
      newCount.AddRange(count.GetRange(n - i + 1, count.Count - (n - i + 1)));
      counts.Add(newCount);
    end;
  end;
end;

function SearchFun(arr: List<integer>; left, right: integer): integer;
begin
  var mid := (left + right) div 2;
  
  if left > right then
  begin
    Result := -1;
    exit;
  end;
  
  if (arr[mid] > arr[mid - 1]) and (arr[mid] > arr[mid + 1]) then
    Result := mid
  else
  begin
    if (mid < arr.Count - 1) and (arr[mid] < arr[mid + 1]) then
      Result := SearchFun(arr, mid + 1, right)
    else if (mid < arr.Count - 1) and (arr[mid] > arr[mid + 1]) then
      Result := SearchFun(arr, left, mid - 1)
    else
      Result := -1;
  end;
end;

function PeakIndexInMountainArray(arr: List<integer>): integer;
begin
  if arr.Count = 0 then
  begin
    Result := -1;
    exit;
  end;
  
  if arr.Count = 1 then
  begin
    Result := 0;
    exit;
  end;
  
  Result := SearchFun(arr, 0, arr.Count - 1);
end;

begin
end.

instruction: Write a function to find the minimum length encoding for a list of words. The encoding should represent each word as a sequence of characters followed by a hash symbol (#). The goal is to find the shortest possible encoding that represents all words without any ambiguity.
output:
type
  TreeNode = class
  public
    children: Dictionary<char, TreeNode>;
    
    constructor;
    begin
      children := new Dictionary<char, TreeNode>;
    end;
  end;

function MinimumLengthEncoding(words: List<string>): integer;
begin
  var root := new TreeNode;
  var leaves := new List<(TreeNode, integer)>;
  
  // Build tree with words in reverse order
  foreach var word in words do
  begin
    var node := root;
    for var i := word.Length - 1 downto 0 do
    begin
      var c := word[i];
      if not node.children.ContainsKey(c) then
        node.children.Add(c, new TreeNode);
      node := node.children[c];
    end;
    leaves.Add((node, word.Length + 1)); // +1 for '#'
  end;
  
  // Count only leaf nodes (nodes with no children)
  var res := 0;
  foreach var leaf in leaves do
    if leaf[0].children.Count = 0 then
      res := res + leaf[1];
  
  Result := res;
end;

begin
end.

instruction: Write a function to find the kth smallest element in a given unsorted array using QuickSelect algorithm.
output:
function Partition(nums: List<integer>; low, high: integer): integer;
begin
  var pivot := nums[high];
  var i := low - 1;
  
  for var j := low to high - 1 do
  begin
    if nums[j] <= pivot then
    begin
      i := i + 1;
      var temp := nums[i];
      nums[i] := nums[j];
      nums[j] := temp;
    end;
  end;
  
  var temp := nums[i + 1];
  nums[i + 1] := nums[high];
  nums[high] := temp;
  
  Result := i + 1;
end;

function QuickSelect(nums: List<integer>; k, low, high: integer): integer;
begin
  if low = high then
  begin
    Result := nums[low];
    exit;
  end;
  
  var pivotIndex := Partition(nums, low, high);
  
  if k = pivotIndex then
    Result := nums[k]
  else if k < pivotIndex then
    Result := QuickSelect(nums, k, low, pivotIndex - 1)
  else
    Result := QuickSelect(nums, k, pivotIndex + 1, high);
end;

function KthSmallestElement(nums: List<integer>; k: integer): integer;
begin
  if (k < 1) or (k > nums.Count) then
    raise new System.ArgumentException('k is out of bounds!');
  
  Result := QuickSelect(nums, k - 1, 0, nums.Count - 1);
end;

begin
end.

function KnightMoves(x1, y1, x2, y2: integer): integer;
begin
  var moves := new List<(integer, integer)>;
  moves.Add((2, 1));
  moves.Add((1, 2));
  moves.Add((-1, -2));
  moves.Add((-2, -1));
  moves.Add((-2, 1));
  moves.Add((-1, 2));
  moves.Add((1, -2));
  moves.Add((2, -1));
  
  var queue := new Queue<(integer, integer, integer)>;
  queue.Enqueue((x1, y1, 0));
  var visited := new HashSet<(integer, integer)>;
  visited.Add((x1, y1));
  
  while queue.Count > 0 do
  begin
    var (x, y, c) := queue.Dequeue;
    
    if (x = x2) and (y = y2) then
    begin
      Result := c;
      exit;
    end;
    
    foreach var (dx, dy) in moves do
    begin
      var nx := x + dx;
      var ny := y + dy;
      
      if (nx >= 0) and (nx < 8) and (ny >= 0) and (ny < 8) and (not visited.Contains((nx, ny))) then
      begin
        visited.Add((nx, ny));
        queue.Enqueue((nx, ny, c + 1));
      end;
    end;
  end;
  
  Result := -1;
end;

function MaxAreaHistogram(heights: List<integer>): integer;
begin
  var stack := new Stack<integer>;
  var maxArea := 0;
  var index := 0;
  
  while index < heights.Count do
  begin
    if (stack.Count = 0) or (heights[stack.Peek] <= heights[index]) then
    begin
      stack.Push(index);
      index := index + 1;
    end
    else
    begin
      var top := stack.Pop;
      var area := heights[top] * (if stack.Count = 0 then index else (index - stack.Peek - 1));
      maxArea := Max(maxArea, area);
    end;
  end;
  
  while stack.Count > 0 do
  begin
    var top := stack.Pop;
    var area := heights[top] * (if stack.Count = 0 then index else (index - stack.Peek - 1));
    maxArea := Max(maxArea, area);
  end;
  
  Result := maxArea;
end;

begin
end.

    if currSum = s then

    if sumMap.ContainsKey(currSum) then
      sumMap[currSum] := sumMap[currSum] + 1

  while low <= high do
  begin
    var mid := (low + high) div 2;
    
    if arr[mid] = target then
    begin
      resultIndex := mid;
      high := mid - 1;
    end
    else if arr[mid] > target then
      high := mid - 1
    else
      low := mid + 1;

  Result := dp[i, j];

function CheckWinner(board: array of array of char): integer;
begin
  var oCnt := 0;
  var xCnt := 0;
  var oFlag := False;
  var xFlag := False;
  
  foreach var line in board do
  begin
    var oLine := line.CountOf('O');
    var xLine := line.CountOf('X');
    oCnt += oLine;
    xCnt += xLine;
    if oLine = 3 then
      oFlag := True;
    if xLine = 3 then
      xFlag := True;
  end;
  
  for var idx := 0 to 2 do
  begin
    if (board[0][idx] = 'O') and (board[1][idx] = 'O') and (board[2][idx] = 'O') then
      oFlag := True
    else if (board[0][idx] = 'X') and (board[1][idx] = 'X') and (board[2][idx] = 'X') then
      xFlag := True;
  end;
  
  if ((board[0][0] = 'O') and (board[1][1] = 'O') and (board[2][2] = 'O')) or
     ((board[0][2] = 'O') and (board[1][1] = 'O') and (board[2][0] = 'O')) then
    oFlag := True
  else if ((board[0][0] = 'X') and (board[1][1] = 'X') and (board[2][2] = 'X')) or
          ((board[0][2] = 'X') and (board[1][1] = 'X') and (board[2][0] = 'X')) then
    xFlag := True;
  
  if oFlag and not xFlag then
    Result := 1
  else if xFlag and not oFlag then

instruction: Write a function to convert infix expression to postfix expression.

function InfixToPostfix(expression: string): string;
begin
  var prec := new Dictionary<char, integer>;
  prec['*'] := 3;
  prec['/'] := 3;
  prec['+'] := 2;
  prec['-'] := 2;
  prec['('] := 1;
  
  var opStack := new Stack<char>;
  var postfixList := new List<string>;
  var tokenList := expression.ToWords();

  foreach var token in tokenList do
  begin
    if (token[1] in ['A'..'Z']) or (token[1] in ['0'..'9']) then
      postfixList.Add(token)
    else if token = '(' then
      opStack.Push('(')
    else if token = ')' then
    begin
      var topToken := opStack.Pop();
      while topToken <> '(' do
      begin
        postfixList.Add(topToken.ToString());
        topToken := opStack.Pop();
      end;
    end
    else
    begin
      while (opStack.Count <> 0) and (prec[opStack.Peek()] >= prec[token[1]]) do
        postfixList.Add(opStack.Pop().ToString());
      opStack.Push(token[1]);
    end;
  end;

  while opStack.Count <> 0 do
    postfixList.Add(opStack.Pop().ToString());
  
  Result := string.Join(' ', postfixList);
end;

begin
end.

  begin
    Result := 0;
    exit;
  end;

  var stopToRoutes := new Dictionary<integer, HashSet<integer>>;
  for var i := 0 to routes.Length - 1 do
  begin
    for var j := 0 to routes[i].Length - 1 do
    begin
      var stop := routes[i][j];
      if not stopToRoutes.ContainsKey(stop) then
        stopToRoutes[stop] := new HashSet<integer>;
      stopToRoutes[stop].Add(i);
    end;
  end;

  var queue := new Queue<(integer, integer)>;
  queue.Enqueue((source, 0));
  var visitedStops := new HashSet<integer>;
  visitedStops.Add(source);
  var visitedRoutes := new HashSet<integer>;

  while queue.Count > 0 do
  begin
    var (currStop, buses) := queue.Dequeue;
    
    if stopToRoutes.ContainsKey(currStop) then
    begin
      foreach var route in stopToRoutes[currStop] do
      begin
        if visitedRoutes.Contains(route) then
          continue;
        
        visitedRoutes.Add(route);
        
        for var k := 0 to routes[route].Length - 1 do
        begin
          var stop := routes[route][k];
          if stop = target then
          begin
            Result := buses + 1;
            exit;
          end;
          
          if not visitedStops.Contains(stop) then
          begin
            visitedStops.Add(stop);
            queue.Enqueue((stop, buses + 1));
          end;
        end;
      end;
    end;
  end;
  
  Result := -1;
end;

instruction: Write a function to find the maximum number of points that can be covered by a circle of given radius. The points are represented as a list of tuples, where each tuple contains the x and y coordinates of a point. The function should return the maximum number of points that can be covered by a circle of the given radius.

function GetMid(a, b: (real, real); r: real): ((real, real), (real, real));
begin
  var (ax, ay) := a;
  var (bx, by) := b;
  var lx := bx - ax;
  var ly := by - ay;
  var lxy := Sqrt(lx * lx + ly * ly);
  var r2 := r * r;
  
  if (lxy / 2) * (lxy / 2) > r2 then
    Result := ((0.0, 0.0), (0.0, 0.0))
  else
  begin
    var l := Sqrt(r2 - (lxy / 2) * (lxy / 2));
    var yy := l * lx / lxy;
    var xx := l * ly / lxy;
    var mx := (ax + bx) / 2;
    var my := (ay + by) / 2;
    Result := ((mx + xx, my - yy), (mx - xx, my + yy));
  end;
end;

function IsIn(rx, ry, x, y, r: real): boolean;
begin
  var r2 := r * r;
  Result := (rx - x) * (rx - x) + (ry - y) * (ry - y) <= r2 + 0.01;
end;

function CountIn(rx, ry: real; points: array of (real, real); r: real): integer;
begin
  var cnt := 0;
  for var i := 0 to points.Length - 1 do
  begin
    var (x, y) := points[i];
    if IsIn(rx, ry, x, y, r) then
      cnt += 1;
  end;
  Result := cnt;
end;

function MaxPointsCovered(points: array of (real, real); r: real): integer;
begin
  var maxRes := 1;
  var mapT := new HashSet<(real, real)>;

  for var ii := 0 to points.Length - 1 do
  begin
    for var jj := ii + 1 to points.Length - 1 do
    begin
      var (c1, c2) := GetMid(points[ii], points[jj], r);
      var (rx1, ry1) := c1;
      var (rx2, ry2) := c2;
      
      if rx1 = 0.0 then
        continue;
        
      var cnt1 := 0;
      if not mapT.Contains((rx1, ry1)) then
        cnt1 := CountIn(rx1, ry1, points, r);
        
      var cnt2 := 0;
      if not mapT.Contains((rx2, ry2)) then
        cnt2 := CountIn(rx2, ry2, points, r);
        
      mapT.Add((rx1, ry1));
      mapT.Add((rx2, ry2));
      maxRes := Max(maxRes, Max(cnt1, cnt2));
    end;
  end;
  
  Result := maxRes;
end;

begin
end.

function MinimumSwaps(arr: array of integer): integer;
begin
  var n := arr.Length;
  var ans := 0;
  var temp := arr.ToArray;
  &Array.Sort(temp);
  var visited := new boolean[n];
  
  for var i := 0 to n - 1 do
  begin
    if visited[i] or (temp[i] = arr[i]) then
      continue;
  
    var cycleSize := 0;
    var j := i;
    
    while not visited[j] do
    begin
      visited[j] := true;
      var index := &Array.IndexOf(temp, arr[j]);
      j := index;
      cycleSize += 1;
    end;
  
    if cycleSize > 0 then
      ans += cycleSize - 1;
  end;

end;

function BinaryInsertionSort(arr: array of integer): array of integer;
begin
  var res := arr.ToArray;
  
  for var i := 1 to res.Length - 1 do
  begin
    var val := res[i];
    var left := 0;
    var right := i - 1;
    
    while left <= right do
    begin
      var mid := (left + right) div 2;
      if res[mid] > val then
        right := mid - 1
      else
        left := mid + 1;
    end;
    
    for var j := i - 1 downto left do
      res[j + 1] := res[j];
    
    res[left] := val;
  end;
  
  Result := res;
end;

end;

  nums2.RemoveAll(x -> x = 0);

  while (i < nums1.Count) and (j < nums2.Count) do
  begin
    if nums1[i] <= nums2[j] then
      i += 1
    else
    begin
      nums1.Insert(i, nums2[j]);
      i += 1;
      j += 1;
    end;
  end;
  
  if j < nums2.Count then

  Result := nums1;
end;

function IsPerfect(n: integer): boolean;
begin
  if n = 1 then
  begin
    Result := False;
    exit;
  end;
  
  var sum := 1;
  var i := 2;
  while i <= n / i do
  begin
    if n mod i = 0 then
      sum += i + (n div i);
    i += 1;
  end;
  
  if i * i = n then
    sum -= i;
    
  Result := sum = n;
end;

    var subsets := FindCombinations(remaining, k - 1);
    foreach var subset in subsets do

      var newComb := new integer[subset.Length + 1];
      newComb[0] := nums[i];
      for var j := 0 to subset.Length - 1 do

function FindCycleSize(node: integer; var localInDegree: array of integer; edges: array of integer): integer;
begin
  if localInDegree[node] = 0 then
  begin
    Result := 0;
    exit;
  end;
  
  localInDegree[node] -= 1;
  Result := 1 + FindCycleSize(edges[node], localInDegree, edges);
end;

function LongestCycle(edges: array of integer): integer;
begin
  var inDegree := new integer[edges.Length];
  var queue := new Queue<integer>();
  
  for var i := 0 to edges.Length - 1 do
    if edges[i] <> -1 then
      inDegree[edges[i]] += 1;
  
  for var i := 0 to edges.Length - 1 do
    if inDegree[i] = 0 then
      queue.Enqueue(i);
  
  while queue.Count > 0 do
  begin
    var node := queue.Dequeue();
    if edges[node] <> -1 then
    begin
      inDegree[edges[node]] -= 1;
      if inDegree[edges[node]] = 0 then
        queue.Enqueue(edges[node]);
    end;
  end;
  
  var maxCycle := -1;
  var tempInDegree := Copy(inDegree);
  for var i := 0 to edges.Length - 1 do
  begin
    if tempInDegree[i] <> 0 then
    begin
      var cycleSize := FindCycleSize(i, tempInDegree, edges);
      if cycleSize > maxCycle then
        maxCycle := cycleSize;
    end;
  end;
  
  Result := maxCycle;
end;

begin
end.

function CountOccurrences(SourceText, Pattern: string; IgnoreCase: boolean := True): integer;
begin
  if string.IsNullOrEmpty(SourceText) or string.IsNullOrEmpty(Pattern) then
  begin
    CountOccurrences := 0;
    exit;
  end;

  var TextCopy := SourceText;
  var PatternCopy := Pattern;
  if IgnoreCase then
  begin
    TextCopy := TextCopy.ToLower;
    PatternCopy := PatternCopy.ToLower;
  end;

  var Count := 0;
  var Index := TextCopy.IndexOf(PatternCopy);
  while Index <> -1 do
  begin
    Count += 1;
    Index := TextCopy.IndexOf(PatternCopy, Index + PatternCopy.Length);
  end;

  CountOccurrences := Count;
end;

begin
  var S := 'abracadabra';
  var Sub := 'abra';

  var Occ := CountOccurrences(S, Sub);
  if Occ > 0 then
    Println($'Substring "{Sub}" found {Occ} time(s).')
  else
    Println($'Substring "{Sub}" not found.');
end.

function CalculateMedian(numbers: array of integer): integer;
begin
  if numbers.Length = 0 then
  begin
    Result := 0;
    exit;
  end;
  
  if numbers.Length = 1 then
  begin
    Result := numbers[0];
    exit;
  end;
  
  // Manual sorting using bubble sort (since built-in sorting is not allowed)
  for var i := 0 to numbers.Length - 2 do
    for var j := 0 to numbers.Length - i - 2 do
      if numbers[j] > numbers[j + 1] then
      begin
        var temp := numbers[j];
        numbers[j] := numbers[j + 1];
        numbers[j + 1] := temp;
      end;
  
  var middleIndex := numbers.Length div 2;
  
  if numbers.Length mod 2 = 0 then
  begin
    // For even length, average of two middle values
    Result := (numbers[middleIndex] + numbers[middleIndex - 1]) div 2;
  end
  else
  begin
    // For odd length, middle value
    Result := numbers[middleIndex];
  end;
end;

function LongestCommonSubsequence(S1, S2: string): string;
begin
  if (S1 = nil) or (S2 = nil) then
  begin
    LongestCommonSubsequence := '';
    exit;
  end;

  var N := S1.Length;
  var M := S2.Length;

  var Dp := new integer[N + 1, M + 1];

  for var I := 1 to N do
    for var J := 1 to M do
      if S1[I] = S2[J] then
        Dp[I, J] := Dp[I - 1, J - 1] + 1
      else
        Dp[I, J] := Max(Dp[I - 1, J], Dp[I, J - 1]);

  // Reconstruct subsequence
  var I := N;
  var J := M;
  var Builder := new System.Text.StringBuilder;

  while (I > 0) and (J > 0) do
  begin
    if S1[I] = S2[J] then
    begin
      Builder.Insert(0, S1[I]);
      I -= 1;
      J -= 1;
    end
    else if Dp[I - 1, J] >= Dp[I, J - 1] then
      I -= 1
    else
      J -= 1;
  end;

  LongestCommonSubsequence := Builder.ToString;
end;

begin
  var A := 'character';
  var B := 'chart';
  Println('LCS: ', LongestCommonSubsequence(A, B));
end.

procedure QuickSort(var Arr: array of integer; Left, Right: integer);
begin
  var I := Left;
  var J := Right;
  var Pivot := Arr[(Left + Right) div 2];

  while I <= J do
  begin
    while Arr[I] < Pivot do
      I += 1;
    while Arr[J] > Pivot do
      J -= 1;

    if I <= J then
    begin
      var Temp := Arr[I];
      Arr[I] := Arr[J];
      Arr[J] := Temp;
      I += 1;
      J -= 1;
    end;
  end;

    QuickSort(Arr, Left, J);
  if I < Right then
    QuickSort(Arr, I, Right);

function RemoveDuplicates(const Arr: array of integer): array of integer;
begin
  if Arr.Length = 0 then
  begin
    Result := Arr;
    exit;
  end;

  var UniqueList := new List<integer>;
  var Previous := Arr[0];
  UniqueList.Add(Previous);

  for var Index := 1 to Arr.Length - 1 do
  begin
    var Current := Arr[Index];
    if Current <> Previous then
    begin
      UniqueList.Add(Current);
      Previous := Current;
    end;
  end;

  Result := UniqueList.ToArray;
end;

begin

  Println('Original array: ', Numbers);

  QuickSort(Numbers, 0, Numbers.Length - 1);

end.

function NormalizeSpaces(SourceText: string): string;
begin
  var Parts := SourceText.Split(' ');
  var Words := new List<string>;
  foreach var Part in Parts do
    if Part <> '' then
      Words.Add(Part);
  NormalizeSpaces := string.Join(' ', Words.ToArray);
end;

function CapitalizeWords(SourceText: string): string;
begin
  if string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(SourceText) then
  begin
    CapitalizeWords := '';
    exit;
  end;

  var Parts := SourceText.Split(' ');
  for var Index := 0 to Parts.Length - 1 do
    if Parts[Index] <> '' then
    begin
      var Word := Parts[Index];
      var Chars := Word.ToCharArray;
      Chars[0] := System.Char.ToUpper(Chars[0]);
      for var J := 1 to Chars.Length - 1 do
        Chars[J] := System.Char.ToLower(Chars[J]);
      Parts[Index] := new string(Chars);
    end;

  CapitalizeWords := string.Join(' ', Parts);
end;

begin
  var InputText := '  hello  world    how are you   ';
  var Trimmed := InputText.Trim;
  var SingleSpaced := NormalizeSpaces(Trimmed);

  Print('Enter replacement word (e.g. universe): ');

  // Replace whole words ignoring case
  var Words := Capitalized.Split(' ');
  for var Index := 0 to Words.Length - 1 do
    if Words[Index].ToLower = SpecificWord then
      Words[Index] := ReplacementWord[1].ToUpper + ReplacementWord.Substring(1);

  var ResultText := string.Join(' ', Words);
  Println('Result text: ', ResultText);
end.

The program should be able to handle large arrays with up to 1 million elements efficiently. Additionally, the program should minimize the memory usage and perform the removal operation in place without creating a new array. The program should also maintain the order of the remaining elements after the removal operation is performed. However, the program should now also support multi-dimensional arrays and remove the item from all dimensions of the array.

function RemoveItem(const Source: array[,] of integer; ItemValue: integer): array[,] of integer;
begin
  var Rows := Source.GetLength(0);
  var Cols := Source.GetLength(1);

  var TempList := new List<integer>;
  for var I := 0 to Rows - 1 do
    for var J := 0 to Cols - 1 do
    begin
      var Value := Source[I, J];
      if Value <> ItemValue then
        TempList.Add(Value);
    end;

  if TempList.Count = 0 then
  begin
    Result := new integer[0, 0];
    exit;
  end;

  // Create a new rectangular array with one row
  var ResultCols := TempList.Count;
  var NewArr := new integer[1, ResultCols];
  for var Index := 0 to TempList.Count - 1 do
    NewArr[0, Index] := TempList[Index];

  Result := NewArr;
end;

begin
  var Data: array[,] of integer := ((1, 2, 3), (2, 2, 4), (5, 2, 6));
  Println('Original array:');
  for var I := 0 to Data.GetLength(0) - 1 do
  begin
    for var J := 0 to Data.GetLength(1) - 1 do
      Print(Data[I, J]);
    Println;
  end;

  var ItemValue := 2;
  var Cleaned := RemoveItem(Data, ItemValue);

  Println;
  Println($'Array after removing {ItemValue}:');
  for var J := 0 to Cleaned.GetLength(1) - 1 do
    Print(Cleaned[0, J]);
  Println;
end.

procedure SortArrayDescending(var arr: array of integer);
begin
  var frequencyMap := new Dictionary<integer, integer>();
  
  // Count the frequency of each element in the array
  foreach var num in arr do
  begin
    if frequencyMap.ContainsKey(num) then
      frequencyMap[num] += 1
    else
      frequencyMap[num] := 1;
  end;
  
  // Sort the array based on frequency and value
  &Array.Sort(arr, (a, b) -> 
  begin
    var frequencyComparison := frequencyMap[b].CompareTo(frequencyMap[a]);
    if frequencyComparison = 0 then
      Result := b.CompareTo(a)
    else
      Result := frequencyComparison;
  end);

function IsPrime(number: integer): boolean;
begin
  if number <= 1 then
    Result := false
  else if number <= 3 then
    Result := true
  else if (number mod 2 = 0) or (number mod 3 = 0) then
    Result := false
  else
  begin
    var i := 5;
    while i * i <= number do
    begin
      if (number mod i = 0) or (number mod (i + 2) = 0) then
      begin
        Result := false;
        exit;
      end;
      i += 6;
    end;
    Result := true;
  end;
end;

function GenerateRandomPrimeNumber(minValue, maxValue: integer): integer;
begin
  var stopwatch := new System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch;
  stopwatch.Start;
  
  while stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds < 1000 do
  begin
    var number := PABCSystem.Random(minValue, maxValue);
    if IsPrime(number) then
    begin
      stopwatch.Stop;
      Result := number;
      exit;
    end;
  end;
  
  stopwatch.Stop;
  raise new System.TimeoutException('Time limit exceeded.');
end;

begin
  var generatedPrime := GenerateRandomPrimeNumber(1000, 2000);
  Println('Generated Prime Number: ', generatedPrime);
end.

    Result := 'zero'

    Result := 'minus ' + ConvertToWords(Abs(number))
  else
  begin
    var words := '';
    
    if (number div 1000000000000) > 0 then

      words += ConvertToWords(number div 1000000000000) + ' trillion ';

      number := number mod 100;

      if words <> '' then
        words += 'and ';

      if number < 20 then
        words += units[number]
      else
      begin
        words += tens[number div 10];
        if (number mod 10) > 0 then

      end;
    end;
    
    Result := words.Trim;
  end;

function IsPrime(number: integer): boolean;
begin
  if number <= 1 then
    Result := false
  else if number = 2 then
    Result := true
  else if number mod 2 = 0 then
    Result := false
  else
  begin
    var sqrtNum := Trunc(Sqrt(number));
    for var i := 3 to sqrtNum step 2 do
    begin
      if number mod i = 0 then
      begin
        Result := false;
        exit;
      end;
    end;
    Result := true;
  end;
end;

  if index < 1 then

  else if index > input.Length then
    Result := input.Length
  else
    Result := index;

function GetNextPrimeIndex(input: string; index: integer): integer;
begin
  var nextIndex := index + 1;
  while (nextIndex <= input.Length) and not IsPrime(Ord(input[nextIndex])) do
  begin
    nextIndex += 1;
  end;
  Result := nextIndex;
end;

function InsertCharacter(input: string; index: integer; character: char): string;
begin
  var lastIndex := input.Length;
  var xorResult := Ord(input[index]) xor Ord(input[lastIndex]);
  var insertedCharacter := Chr(xorResult);
  
  if IsPrime(xorResult) then
    index := GetNextPrimeIndex(input, index)
  else
    index := GetValidIndex(input, index);
  
  Result := input.Insert(index - 1, insertedCharacter.ToString);
end;

function IsPrime(number: int64): boolean;
begin
  if number < 2 then
    Result := false
  else
  begin
    for var i := 2 to Trunc(Sqrt(number)) do
    begin
      if number mod i = 0 then
      begin
        Result := false;
        exit;
      end;
    end;
    Result := true;
  end;
end;

function HasUniqueDigits(number: int64): boolean;
begin
  var digits := new System.Collections.Generic.HashSet&<integer>;
  while number > 0 do
  begin
    var digit := integer(number mod 10);
    if digits.Contains(digit) then
    begin
      Result := false;
      exit;
    end;
    digits.Add(digit);
    number := number div 10;
  end;
  Result := true;
end;

function GenerateFibonacciNumbers(limit: integer): List<int64>;
begin
  Result := new List&<int64>;
  Result.Add(0); // First Fibonacci number
  Result.Add(1); // Second Fibonacci number
  
  for var i := 2 to limit - 1 do
  begin
    var newNumber := Result[i - 1] + Result[i - 2];
    if IsPrime(newNumber) and (newNumber mod 5 = 0) and HasUniqueDigits(newNumber) then
      Result.Add(newNumber);
  end;
end;

begin
  var limit := 100;
  var fibonacciNumbers := GenerateFibonacciNumbers(limit);
  
  foreach var number in fibonacciNumbers do
    Println(number);
end.

function FindSecondSmallestDC(arr: array of integer; left, right: integer): integer;
begin
  if left = right then
    Result := integer.MaxValue
  else if right - left = 1 then
    Result := Min(arr[left], arr[right])
  else
  begin
    var mid := (left + right) div 2;
    var leftSecondSmallest := FindSecondSmallestDC(arr, left, mid);
    var rightSecondSmallest := FindSecondSmallestDC(arr, mid + 1, right);
    Result := Min(leftSecondSmallest, rightSecondSmallest);
  end;
end;

function FindSecondSmallest(arr: array of integer): integer;
begin
  var n := arr.Length;
  var smallest := integer.MaxValue;
  var secondSmallest := integer.MaxValue;
  
  for var i := 0 to n - 1 do
  begin
    if arr[i] < smallest then
    begin
      secondSmallest := smallest;
      smallest := arr[i];
    end
    else if (arr[i] < secondSmallest) and (arr[i] <> smallest) then
      secondSmallest := arr[i];
  end;
  
  Result := secondSmallest;
end;

begin
  var arr := Arr(5, 8, 1, 3, 9, 4, 2, 7, 6);
  
  var secondSmallest := FindSecondSmallest(arr);
  Println('Second Smallest Element: ', secondSmallest);
  
  var secondSmallestUsingDC := FindSecondSmallestDC(arr, 0, arr.Length - 1);
  Println('Second Smallest Element (using divide and conquer): ', secondSmallestUsingDC);
end.

To solve this problem without using built-in data structures, you can follow the following steps:

1. Initialize a variable called "bitmap" as an integer with a value of 0. This bitmap will be used to keep track of which characters have been encountered.

2. Loop through each character in the string.

3. For each character, calculate its corresponding bit position by subtracting the ASCII value of 'a' (or 'A' if the string can contain uppercase characters) from the ASCII value of the character. This will give a unique number between 0 and 25 (assuming only lowercase or uppercase letters are allowed).

4. Check if the bit at the calculated position in the bitmap is set to 1. If it is, return false as it means the character has already been encountered before.

5. If the bit at the calculated position is 0, set it to 1 in the bitmap to mark that the character has been encountered.

function IsUniqueCharacters(const str: string): boolean;
begin
  var bitmap: integer := 0;
  
  for var i := 1 to str.Length do
  begin
    var bitPosition := Ord(LowerCase(str[i])) - Ord('a');
    
    if (bitmap and (1 shl bitPosition)) <> 0 then
      Result := false
    else
      bitmap := bitmap or (1 shl bitPosition);
  end;
  
  Result := true;
end;

// Usage example
begin
  var str := 'abcdefg';
  var res := IsUniqueCharacters(str);
  Println(res); // Output: True
  
  var str2 := 'hello';
  var res2 := IsUniqueCharacters(str2);
  Println(res2); // Output: False
end.

The program should then prompt the user to choose whether they want to calculate the area using the formula (1/2 * base * height) or by inputting the lengths of all three sides using the Heron's formula. If the user chooses the Heron's formula, the program should validate that the input lengths can form a valid triangle. 

To validate if the input lengths can form a valid triangle, the program should check if the sum of any two sides is greater than the third side. 

Finally, the program should round the calculated area to the nearest integer and display it to the user.

function IsValidTriangle(side1, side2, side3: integer): boolean;
begin
  Result := (side1 + side2 > side3) and 
            (side2 + side3 > side1) and 
            (side3 + side1 > side2);
end;

begin
  Write('Enter the base of the triangle: ');
  var baseInput := ReadString();
  
  Write('Enter the height of the triangle: ');
  var heightInput := ReadString();
  
  var baseValue, heightValue: integer;
  
  if not integer.TryParse(baseInput, baseValue) or (baseValue <= 0) then
  begin

    exit;
  end;
  
  if not integer.TryParse(heightInput, heightValue) or (heightValue <= 0) then
  begin
    Println('Invalid height value! Please enter a positive integer.');
    exit;
  end;
  
  Println('Choose the calculation method:');
  Println('1. Calculate using the formula (1/2 * base * height)');
  Println('2. Calculate using Heron''s formula (enter the lengths of all three sides)');
  Write('Enter your choice: ');
  var calculationMethodInput := ReadString();
  
  var calculationMethod: integer;
  if not integer.TryParse(calculationMethodInput, calculationMethod) or 
     ((calculationMethod <> 1) and (calculationMethod <> 2)) then
  begin
    Println('Invalid calculation method choice! Please enter 1 or 2.');
    exit;
  end;
  
  var area := 0.0;
  
  if calculationMethod = 1 then
  begin
    area := 0.5 * baseValue * heightValue;
  end
  else if calculationMethod = 2 then
  begin
    Write('Enter the length of side 1: ');
    var side1Input := ReadString();
    Write('Enter the length of side 2: ');
    var side2Input := ReadString();
    Write('Enter the length of side 3: ');
    var side3Input := ReadString();
    
    var side1, side2, side3: integer;
    
    if not integer.TryParse(side1Input, side1) or (side1 <= 0) or
       not integer.TryParse(side2Input, side2) or (side2 <= 0) or
       not integer.TryParse(side3Input, side3) or (side3 <= 0) then
    begin
      Println('Invalid side lengths! Please enter positive integers for all three sides.');
      exit;
    end;
    
    if IsValidTriangle(side1, side2, side3) then
    begin
      var semiPerimeter := (side1 + side2 + side3) / 2.0;
      area := Sqrt(semiPerimeter * (semiPerimeter - side1) * 
                   (semiPerimeter - side2) * (semiPerimeter - side3));
    end
    else
    begin
      Println('Invalid side lengths! They cannot form a valid triangle.');
      exit;
    end;
  end;
  
  var roundedArea := Round(area);
  Println('The area of the triangle is: ', roundedArea);
end.

For example, if the input string is "Mississippi" and the given character is 'i', the method should return the count as 4 and the positions as [1, 4, 7, 10], indicating the positions of 'i' and 'I' in the string.

Note: The positions should be returned in ascending order.

function CountOccurrences(const input: string; character: char): (integer, List<integer>);
begin
  var count := 0;
  var positions := new List<integer>();
  
  for var i := 1 to input.Length do
  begin
    var currentChar := input[i];
    
    if (currentChar = character) or 
       (char.IsLower(character) and 
        (char.ToUpper(currentChar) = char.ToUpper(character))) then
    begin
      count += 1;
      positions.Add(i);
    end;
  end;
  
  Result := (count, positions);
end;

begin
  var input := 'Mississippi';
  var character := 'i';
  var (count, positions) := CountOccurrences(input, character);
  
  Println('Count: ', count);
  Print('Positions: ');
  foreach var pos in positions do

function StringToInteger(const str: string): integer;
begin
  var trimmedStr := str.Trim();
  
  if string.IsNullOrEmpty(trimmedStr) then
  begin
    Result := 0;
    exit;
  end;
  
  var isNegative := false;
  var startIndex := 1;
  
  if (trimmedStr[1] = '+') or (trimmedStr[1] = '-') then
  begin
    if trimmedStr[1] = '-' then
      isNegative := true;
    startIndex := 2;
  end;
  
  if (trimmedStr.Length >= startIndex + 2) and 
     (trimmedStr[startIndex] = '0') and 
     ((trimmedStr[startIndex + 1] = 'x') or (trimmedStr[startIndex + 1] = 'X')) then
  begin
    var value := 0;
    for var i := startIndex + 2 to trimmedStr.Length do
    begin
      var c := trimmedStr[i];
      if (c >= '0') and (c <= '9') then
        value := value * 16 + (Ord(c) - Ord('0'))
      else if (c >= 'a') and (c <= 'f') then
        value := value * 16 + (Ord(c) - Ord('a') + 10)
      else if (c >= 'A') and (c <= 'F') then
        value := value * 16 + (Ord(c) - Ord('A') + 10)
      else
      begin
        Result := 0;
        exit;
      end;
    end;
    
    if isNegative then
      value := -value;
    Result := value;
  end
  else
  begin
    var value := 0;
    for var i := startIndex to trimmedStr.Length do
    begin
      var c := trimmedStr[i];
      if (c >= '0') and (c <= '9') then
        value := value * 10 + (Ord(c) - Ord('0'))
      else
      begin
        Result := 0;
        exit;
      end;
    end;
    
    if isNegative then
      value := -value;
    Result := value;
  end;
end;

Write a PascalABC.NET class which implements two-dimensional array searching using binary search algorithms. The two-dimensional array contains sorted rows and columns in ascending order. The class should have the following methods:

1. `SearchValue(int[,] arr, int target)`: This method takes in the two-dimensional array `arr` and the target value `target`, and returns the position of the target value in the array. If the target value is not found, it should return (-1, -1). The target value should be within the range of the minimum and maximum values in the array.

2. `SearchRow(int[,] arr, int target)`: This method takes in the two-dimensional array `arr` and the target value `target`, and returns the row index where the target value is found. If the target value is not found in any row, it should return -1. The target value should be within the range of the minimum and maximum values in the array.

3. `SearchColumn(int[,] arr, int target)`: This method takes in the two-dimensional array `arr` and the target value `target`, and returns the column index where the target value is found. If the target value is not found in any column, it should return -1. The target value should be within the range of the minimum and maximum values in the array.

4. `SearchSubmatrix(int[,] arr, int[,] submatrix)`: This method takes in the two-dimensional array `arr` and the submatrix `submatrix`, and returns the position of the top-left element of the submatrix in the array. If the submatrix is not found, it should return (-1, -1). The submatrix should have dimensions less than or equal to the dimensions of the array.

The implementation of these methods should utilize binary search algorithms to efficiently search for the target values.

Please note that the efficiency of the binary search algorithms should be optimized and the code should be well-optimized for performance. Additionally, consider handling edge cases such as invalid input or empty arrays.

type
  TwoDimensionalArraySearch = static class
  public
    class function SearchValue(arr: array[,] of integer; target: integer): (integer, integer);
    class function SearchRow(arr: array[,] of integer; target: integer): integer;
    class function SearchColumn(arr: array[,] of integer; target: integer): integer;
    class function SearchSubmatrix(arr: array[,] of integer; submatrix: array[,] of integer): (integer, integer);
  end;

class function TwoDimensionalArraySearch.SearchValue(arr: array[,] of integer; target: integer): (integer, integer);
begin
  var rows := arr.GetLength(0);
  var cols := arr.GetLength(1);
  
  var left := 0;
  var right := rows * cols - 1;
  
  while left <= right do
  begin
    var mid := left + (right - left) div 2;
    var row := mid div cols;
    var col := mid mod cols;
    var value := arr[row, col];
    
    if value = target then
      Result := (row, col)
    else if value < target then
      left := mid + 1
    else
      right := mid - 1;
  end;
  
  Result := (-1, -1);
end;

class function TwoDimensionalArraySearch.SearchRow(arr: array[,] of integer; target: integer): integer;
begin
  var rows := arr.GetLength(0);
  var cols := arr.GetLength(1);
  
  var left := 0;
  var right := rows - 1;
  
  while left <= right do
  begin
    var mid := left + (right - left) div 2;
    var value := arr[mid, 0];
    
    if value = target then
      Result := mid
    else if value < target then
      left := mid + 1
    else
      right := mid - 1;
  end;
  
  Result := -1;
end;

class function TwoDimensionalArraySearch.SearchColumn(arr: array[,] of integer; target: integer): integer;
begin
  var rows := arr.GetLength(0);
  var cols := arr.GetLength(1);
  
  var left := 0;
  var right := cols - 1;
  
  while left <= right do
  begin
    var mid := left + (right - left) div 2;
    var value := arr[0, mid];
    
    if value = target then
      Result := mid
    else if value < target then
      left := mid + 1
    else
      right := mid - 1;
  end;
  
  Result := -1;
end;

class function TwoDimensionalArraySearch.SearchSubmatrix(arr: array[,] of integer; submatrix: array[,] of integer): (integer, integer);
begin
  var rows := arr.GetLength(0);
  var cols := arr.GetLength(1);
  var subRows := submatrix.GetLength(0);
  var subCols := submatrix.GetLength(1);
  
  for var i := 0 to rows - subRows do
    for var j := 0 to cols - subCols do
    begin
      var found := true;
      
      for var k := 0 to subRows - 1 do
      begin
        for var l := 0 to subCols - 1 do
          if arr[i + k, j + l] <> submatrix[k, l] then
          begin
            found := false;
            break;
          end;
        
        if not found then
          break;
      end;
      
      if found then
      begin
        Result := (i, j);
        exit;
      end;
    end;
  
  Result := (-1, -1);
end;

begin

    (1, 2, 3, 4),
    (5, 6, 7, 8),

- If the integer is even and divisible by 3, it should be sorted in ascending order.
- If the integer is even and not divisible by 3, it should be sorted in descending order.
- If the integer is odd and divisible by 5, it should be sorted in ascending order.
- If the integer is odd and not divisible by 5, it should be sorted in descending order.

- The program should complete the sorting in less than 1 second.
- The program should use a space complexity of O(1).

function ShouldSwap(a, b: integer): boolean;
begin
  if (a mod 2 = 0) and (b mod 2 = 0) then
  begin
    if (a mod 3 = 0) and (b mod 3 <> 0) then
      Result := a > b
    else if (a mod 3 <> 0) and (b mod 3 = 0) then
      Result := a < b
    else
      Result := false;
  end
  else if (a mod 2 <> 0) and (b mod 2 <> 0) then
  begin
    if (a mod 5 = 0) and (b mod 5 <> 0) then
      Result := a > b
    else if (a mod 5 <> 0) and (b mod 5 = 0) then
      Result := a < b
    else
      Result := false;
  end
  else
    Result := false;
end;

procedure CustomSort(var arr: array of integer);
begin
  var n := arr.Length;
  
  for var i := 0 to n - 2 do
    for var j := 0 to n - i - 2 do
      if ShouldSwap(arr[j], arr[j + 1]) then
      begin
        var temp := arr[j];
        arr[j] := arr[j + 1];
        arr[j + 1] := temp;
      end;
end;

begin

  foreach var num in arr do

    var b := 1;
    var c := 0;
    
    for var i := 3 to n do

  var secondCommon := integer.MaxValue;

  // Reset counters for second array
  counter1 := 0;

    if array2[i] = firstCommon then

      counter2 += 1;
    end
    else
    begin
      counter1 -= 1;
      counter2 -= 1;
    end;
  end;
  
  // Determine third common element

  if counter2 > 0 then
    thirdCommon := secondCommon;
  
  Result := thirdCommon;
end;

function ContainsUppercase(s: string): boolean;

function ContainsLowercase(s: string): boolean;

function GenerateRandomHex(): string;
begin
  var guidHex := System.Guid.NewGuid.ToString('N');
  var rnd := new System.Random;
  var specialCharIndex := rnd.Next(0, guidHex.Length);
  var specialChars := '!@#$%^&*';

  // Гарантировать, что сгенерированное значение длиной не менее 8 символов
  while guidHex.Length < 8 do
    guidHex += guidHex;

  // Заменить случайный символ специальным символом
  guidHex := guidHex.Remove(specialCharIndex, 1);
  guidHex := guidHex.Insert(specialCharIndex, specialChars.Chars[rnd.Next(0, specialChars.Length)].ToString);

  // Гарантировать, что сгенерированное значение содержит хотя бы одну заглавную букву
  if not ContainsUppercase(guidHex) then
  begin
    var pos := rnd.Next(0, guidHex.Length);
    guidHex := guidHex.Remove(pos, 1);
    guidHex := guidHex.Insert(pos, 'A');
  end;

  // Гарантировать, что сгенерированное значение содержит хотя бы одну строчную букву

  begin
    var pos := rnd.Next(0, guidHex.Length);
    guidHex := guidHex.Remove(pos, 1);
    guidHex := guidHex.Insert(pos, 'a');
